description: Pushes a text-step workout guide to the user's Suunto account via the SuuntoPlus Guide Cloud API. Each exercise becomes one step, advanced by a lap-button press on the watch. Requires SUUNTO_APP_NAME env var to exactly match the app name registered on apizone.suunto.com. There is no live push to the watch itself — delivery depends on the phone's normal Suunto app sync. In testing it showed up on the watch after the next ordinary sync with no manual pinning needed; if it doesn't appear, check the Suunto app under SuuntoPlus Guides and pin it there. For gym sessions prefer push_strength_guide: it records one lap per set and per rest, which get_workout_laps can read back. Write operation.

detail.description: Sets/reps/weight as one display string, e.g. '60kg 3x10'.

guideId.description: If provided, updates this existing guide instead of creating a new one.

title.description: Short session name shown in the Suunto app, e.g. 'Push A'.

name: push_workout_guide
title: Push workout guide to watch
